comment: I took professor pallant's class for my visual art requirement. A LOT of assigned reading and writing. She is very caring in class but a harsh grader. Only take her class if you are genuienly interested, otherwise it's simply a lot of work for a visual art requirement.

Professor Pallant is such a fun free spirit. She is very passionate about Contact Improvisation and connecting to your body. Not a lot of homework but does assign 2 critique papers and 2 research papers. Her class was fun, low stress and a good workout too. Such a kind soul. Participation and an open mind are SUPER important.
Be ready to write! Be open-minded when you take this class and work with her. You'll do well. She is a sweet, sweet lady!
Great lady. Anyone who says this class is hard to get a good grade in isn't trying or participating. Just show up and show effort and you'll get an A+.
She can grade very hard, but I didnt mind the class.

I took Professor Pallant for Contact Improv. She had some really fascinating stories! It's easy to do well in the course, just be sure to participate and be open to trying new things during class. The papers provided lots of opportunity for student choice, so they were pretty easy as well!

This class is entitled Writing from the body, it was very interesting and extremely different from your normal dance class. There's a lot of writing and she expects you to be as detailed and thoughtful as possible. The class is easy just show up, follow on, and be creative. Class requires you to think outside of the box.

dr. pallant is really laid back and definitely was/is a hippie. she tells you exactly what will be on the tests and her essay assignments are very abstract, for the most part. the only bad part is that she takes attendance EVERYDAY.
easy class but hard to get a good grade
was a lot of fun in class, very encouraging with my own creative writing. she loves writing, and inspired me and many others in the class. she's very laid-back, fun, and fairly easy.
She is very easygoing, and her poetry class is a lot of fun! I would definately recommend it for an easy class to fill your literature gen ed requirement!
